item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 21/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days, it will be generally fine over the region. Under the influence of the replenishment of the monsoon, it will be windy over the coastal areas over the weekend. Besides, a broad area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the Luzon Strait early to midweek next week.
